blocks.html:
Audi A4 2006 Sand Wrap By Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Inspiration can strike from anywhere. Our recent client, Mr. Anthony will relate to that. The Vinyl Wrap Toronto team recently did a full wrap for an Audi A4 2006 with Sand Texture Vinyl having Decals on top.

This story is particularly interesting because it goes on to show how sometimes the things we aim for can differ from the things we end up getting. Initially, the client wanted to go with a camouflage design. The final design was inspired by a beautiful BMW that the customer came across online. Many of our personal wrap customers take inspiration from images or influences they find online.

We started the process to create a digital mock-up for his Audi A4 to show him what his wrap would look like. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we make it our mission to offer our clients advice that is in their best interest. So, while in the process, our team had a talk with the client and made him aware of the potentially better options he could go with. One of those options was a Matte Sand Texture. The client seemed to like that better than what he originally intended So, he made the decision to move forward with the Matte Sand Texture with decals on top.

After the design was approved, we started the printing process. We used Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl from their SW900 series. Then laminated it with Avery Dennison’s Matte lamination. Our installers wrapped the Audi A4 with perfection and installed the Gloss Black Decals on top.

This was a personal wrap and the client wanted to give his car a unique touch of his own. For the Decals, he chose to go with quotes that were close to his heart. The quotes he chose are:

  • “Your journey is different from theirs, keep it moving”.
  • “Still downloading…” – Above the fuel cap with the intention to be funny.

A great choice indeed. The Audi A4 2006 after being wrapped, looked completely different and our customer will testify to that with his sheer joy and excitement. The client told us it feels like buying a new car. We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see.
